g.text: Four failed crop conditions rerun with isotropic coarse transforms.
Within each dataset / perturbation; gray = undefined.
□: final OmniAligner visual review uncertain; original numerical score retained.
Curve ×: native zero-overlap failure (included as 0). No imputation of missing metric values.
Bubble colour encodes variability, not rank: purple = lower variance; green = higher variance.
One section pair per dataset. Statistics include 0° and 360°; no confidence intervals.
